sources.title: GitHub - EricLBuehler/mistral.rs: Fast, flexible LLM inference
sources.snippet: The mistralrs CLI The CLI uses the same run, serve, and bench commands for model repositories, local directories, and GGUF files. Auto-detection: Automatically detects model architecture, quantization format, and chat template All-in-one: Single binary for chat, server, benchmarks, and web UI (run, serve, bench)

sources.title: mistral.rs | mistral.rs
sources.snippet: mistralrs run -m <model> works without flags. The binary infers the architecture and chat template from the Hugging Face repository, and selects the accelerator from the detected hardware.

sources.title: kev/docs/model-cards/kev-9b.md at main · jaredpalmer/kev
sources.snippet: Kev-9B Kev-9B is a decision model: one document (the state) and a set of typed questions in, a probability distribution per question out, in one forward pass. No text generation. It is a LoRA adapter (r=16, 45.4M trainable parameters) plus a pointer head on Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B-Base (revision 68c46c4b), serving TypeSafe's public /v1/systemone contract.

sources.title: Run models | mistral.rs
sources.snippet: For standard model repositories, --quant auto probes your hardware (the same analysis as mistralrs tune) and picks a level, or runs at full precision if the model fits.
